# explicit-port-mode (IDM002)

| Category | Severity | Enabled by default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Idiom | warning | yes |

Checks that port clauses have an explicit mode set.

## Non-compliant example

```vhdl
entity foo is
    port (
        clk : std_logic
    );
end foo;
```

## Compliant example

```vhdl
entity foo is
    port (
        clk : in std_logic
    );
end foo;
```

## Configuration

This rule is enabled by default. To disable it, add it to `ignore` in `vhdl-lint.toml`:

```toml
ignore = ["IDM002"]
```

or pass `--ignore IDM002` on the command line.
